slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether the 110 hours were shared across fabrics, but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether there is a maximum overtime limit and whether it is shared, but did not ask whether the 10-hour overtime limit is a strict constraint or a soft prioritized goal.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 regular hours are a fixed capacity limit, not a prioritized goal to fully utilize.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether fully using 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a hard upper bound rather than a soft goal with priority.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether the overtime limit is a strict constraint or a prioritized goal.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden slots about the goal-programming nature of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified many operational details but missed the two P0 structural issues: whether the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals. It then stopped prematurely with those assumptions unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
